title: Package Types Schema
description: Schema for package type definitions that define how to process files for linting and building

package-types.description: Map of package type name to configuration

package_type.description: A package type definition that describes how to process files of a specific type

extensions.description: File extensions that belong to this package type (e.g., [".go"], [".md"]). Empty for non-file-based packages.

linter.description: The linter tool to use for this package type (e.g., "golangci-lint", "markdownlint-cli2")

lint_input.description: How files are passed to the linter: 'packages' for directory-based (Go), 'files' for file-based

builder.description: The build handler to use for this package type (e.g., "go", "mkdocs", "buildx")

requirements.description: System dependencies required for building/linting this package type (e.g., ["go"], ["docker"])

default_root.description: Default root path pattern for this package type. Supports {moniker} variable for module-specific paths (e.g., 'specs/{moniker}' for specs package).

files.description: Default file patterns for this package type
